info.title: CommsHarbor
info.description: Manage domain email, mailboxes, aliases and durable jobs. Each call uses its organization's identity.

bearerAuth.description: Use an organisation API key (`mmk_…`) for permitted work in that organisation. Account operations require the shared account session. Paid routes accept a global credit token (`cred_…`). Monthly purchases require a recent human session.

globalAccount.name: __Host-mm-auth
globalAccount.description: Global session in the product's HttpOnly cookie; writes require exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token.

contaChaveApi.description: Account API key: `Authorization: Bearer mmk_…` or `X-Api-Key: mmk_…`. Created on the account page (API keys), valid only in the product where it was created; it acts as the account (or the organization that owns it).

carteiraAgente.description: Wallet credential of an agent without an account (`Authorization: Bearer mmw_…`, 30 days, this product only): POST /api/auth/wallet/agent/start, sign the message with the wallet, POST /api/auth/wallet/agent/token. The owner is `x402:<address>`.

description.description: What the product does, in one sentence.

base_url.description: Origin this API is served from.

docs.description: Links to llms.txt, llms-full.txt, openapi.json, the MCP endpoint and the human UI.

auth.description: Every authentication mode and how to obtain it.

endpoints.description: Every endpoint with method, path, auth, absolute URL and what it returns.

ok.description: Always true when the Worker answers.

build.description: Deployed commit; CI passes the short SHA at deploy time.

Health.description: Liveness and the commit currently serving. Smoke tests wait for their own deploy here instead of racing edge propagation.

email.description: Email address verified by the global account.

name.description: Name shown in the interface (empty until the person sets one).

Profile.description: Global MM profile. It belongs to the person, edited on the account, not to any organization.

apiKeyId.description: The organization API key's ID (API key only).

scopes.description: What the API key may do (API key only): the work permissions, never billing, erasure, exports or audit.

role.description: Role inside that organization, from the shared account; null with an API key.

organization.description: `{ id, name }` of the active organization; `name` is null with an API key.

Identity.description: Who the current session or API key resolves to. Read this before a write when you are not sure which organization is active.

id.description: Organization ID in the shared account, used in every tenant route.

name.description: Display name, from the shared account; null with an organization API key.

role.description: Your role in it, from the shared account; null with an organization API key.

email_workspace.description: Tenant-scoped email workspace URL. Read it for the current plan, allowances and resources.

Organization.description: A tenant, opened by id. It lives in the shared account (name, members, roles); CommsHarbor adds the plan. Every piece of customer data in this product is scoped to exactly one.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null when there are no more.

PageCamelAuditEvent.description: The same listing with the cursor in camelCase. Older resources ship it this way and the name is kept because changing it would break clients already reading it.

actor_user_id.description: Who did it; null when the actor was a key or the system.

metadata.description: Extra context for this action. Never contains recipient PII.

AuditEvent.description: One append-only record of something that happened in the organization. Audit is never rewritten.

recurso.description: Product resource: at most 256 characters, without controls. Empty means an account subscription.

id.description: Local subscription ID: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Use it for reads and cancellation.

oferta.description: Offer saved at acceptance. A catalog change does not replace this record.

estado.description: criando, inconclusiva, checkout, aguardando_pagamento, ativa, cancelando, cancelada, falhou or expirada.

simulado.description: Server-recorded environment: true for sandbox, false for production.

pagamento_em.description: Null for API card purchases. Older checkout records can contain an Asaas HTTPS link.

cancelamento_em.description: Cancellation request time in UTC, or null.

cancelado_em.description: Confirmed cancellation time in UTC, or null.

id.description: Offer ID: 2 to 64 characters. Start with a lowercase letter. Use lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.

produto.description: Product ID, with the same format as the offer ID.

renovacao_automatica.description: true: monthly billing continues until cancellation.

acesso_pago.description: until_paid_period_end: keep access until the paid period ends.

teste_dias.description: Configured trial length: 0 to 30 days. Reading the catalog grants no trial or benefit.

conversao_teste.description: opt_in: a trial does not create or renew a subscription.

beneficios.description: 1 to 8 distinct capabilities for each paid period.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the complete offer: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

sku.description: Product capability: a lowercase letter followed by letters, digits or underscores; at most 64 characters.

quantidade.description: 1 to 1,000,000 units for each paid period.

oferta_id.description: Offer ID from the current catalog.

versao.description: Offer version from the current catalog.

renovacao.description: Must be true after explicit acceptance of monthly billing and automatic renewal.

titular.description: Name on the card: 3 to 100 characters.

numero.description: Valid card number: 13 to 19 digits. Spaces and separators are accepted.

ano.description: Four-digit expiry year. The card must not be expired.

cvv.description: Security code: three digits, or four for American Express.

documento.description: Cardholder's valid Brazilian CPF or CNPJ.

cep.description: Cardholder's Brazilian billing postcode: eight digits.

numero_endereco.description: Billing address number: at most 20 characters.

today_contacts.description: Contact messages today. Only with `METRICS_TOKEN`: contact counts never leave without the token.

days.description: One row per day of the window, with each metric's count.

usage.description: `entregas`: deliveries per day — real product usage, not catalog load.

financeiro.description: Day aggregate: `hoje_usd`, `hoje_count`, `rede`. Only with `METRICS_TOKEN`: money never leaves without the token; the full series is `payments`.

Metricas.description: 7-day operator dashboard. `payments` only appears with the token and only on Base mainnet.

post.summary: Start the wallet credential of an agent without an account.
post.description:
No account: the wallet proves it is hers by signing the message (EIP-4361). Signing does not pay or transfer anything. The message names this product and lasts 5 minutes. Sign it with personal_sign and send it to /api/auth/wallet/agent/token.
Returns: { message, issuedAt, expiresIn }

post.summary: Get the wallet credential (mmw_…) of this product.
post.description:
The wallet's signature of the start message, checked here (own key) or on Base (contract, EIP-1271/6492). The credential lasts 30 days: send `Authorization: Bearer mmw_…` to the routes that accept the wallet as owner (owner `x402:<address>`). Once the wallet is linked to an account, what it did here moves to the account when the person signs in.
Returns: { token, owner, expiresAt }

The sign-in window calls it after every sign-in. For each wallet linked to the account: the rights bought here by x402 (owner x402:<address>) and what this product keeps for that owner. Repeating moves nothing.
Returns: { carteiras, direitos }

post.summary: Creates a dynamic Pix: JSON with `oferta` (`pacote` with `usd`, or `saldo` with `centavos`) and the payer.
post.description:
The payment releases what was bought by itself: the pack becomes the `cred_…` token already in the response; the balance goes to the logged-in account's organization. The first purchase needs `documento` (CPF or CNPJ, sent to the gateway and not stored here) and `nome`; `email`, `pagina` and `navegador_id` are optional. With `forma: "cartao_boleto"` the charge is open: the response brings `pagamento_em`, the gateway page where you pay by card, boleto or Pix (due in three days). With `forma: "cartao"` and `cartao` (`titular`, `numero`, `mes`, `ano`, `cvv`, `documento`, `email`, `cep`, `numero_endereco`, `telefone`), the charge is paid by card in the same request: 200 with `estado: "pago"`, 202 with `conferir` while the issuer reviews it, 422 when the card is declined; the card is not stored. Set `usd` to an amount from `pacotes` or `exatos` in the GET response. The server sets the amount in cents and rejects amounts that the app has not declared.
